name: quality-code
description: From a Jira ticket to graded tests, for any project. A short setup (connectors, the project, the Jira project), a daily start from your feature branch, the readiness gate (70 points, Gherkin or 150+ characters of plain criteria), guided fill-in, Jira comment and push, and a check that runs and grades Vitest spec files.

gitlab_api_url.title: GitLab API URL
gitlab_api_url.description: Your GitLab's API address, ending in /api/v4. Used by both GitLab connectors. The default is TeamSystem's GitLab.

gitlab_oauth_client_id.title: GitLab Application ID (browser sign-in)
gitlab_oauth_client_id.description: For signing in to GitLab in the browser: the Application ID of a public (non-confidential) GitLab application with redirect URI http://127.0.0.1:8888/callback and the read_api scope. One person can create it under GitLab Settings > Applications and share the ID. Leave empty to use a token instead.

gitlab_token.title: GitLab token
gitlab_token.description: Instead of browser sign-in: a GitLab personal access token with only the read_api scope. Optional.

figma_api_key.title: Figma API key
figma_api_key.description: Optional, instead of signing in to Figma in the browser: a personal Figma access token.
